text_block_list.text:
One morning, I ran into Curren Bouquetd'or 
in front of the academy. There's still 
plenty of time before classes start, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to take care of the flowers 
today, so I came in early. After all, I'm 
on the Beautification Committee―

As always, I couldn't help but be 
impressed. I wonder what taking care of 
flowers actually entails...?
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, would you let me help?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... are you sure? Thank you so much 
for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "However—fufu— thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of tending to the flower 
vases decorating the academy today—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I bought lots of lovely, 
spring-like flowers at the florist.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If spring could visit the hearts of those 
who watched... that would make me very 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“—First, change the water... For the 
wilted flowers, trim the stems, blanch 
them in hot water... and then add some 
fresh flowers—”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Tulips for the main flower. Let's see... 
Maybe pink would be nice...?
choice_data_list: Oh, nice! What a beautiful color scheme...
Wow, nice! What a pretty color scheme...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness—I thought they would 
match. This baby's breath and the color of 
the vase..."
choice_data_list:
(She really puts a lot of thought into 
these combinations, huh...)

text_block_list.text:
—And so, Curren Bouquetd'or went around 
tending to the many flower vases placed 
throughout the academy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Freesias... Yellow, or purple— Trainer, 
which one do you think is better?
choice_data_list: Let's see... Maybe this one?

text_block_list.text: One by one, gently and carefully—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Place the greens in the back to add 
volume— How does something like that look?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much for your help.
choice_data_list: Good work today.

text_block_list.text:
Making the rounds across the whole academy 
was quite the task. I was impressed all 
over again by her doing this without 
seeking credit. When I told her so...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Please... I'm simply doing this because I 
want to.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Besides... somehow, I felt much more 
excited than usual today—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Is it because I'm with you, Trainer? 
Fufu—I had a wonderful time.
choice_data_list: I had a great time too!
I had a lot of fun too!

text_block_list.text:
She smiled like a gentle spring breeze. 
That day, every time I saw a flower vase 
in the academy, my heart was filled with 
warmth.

Under the blazing sun, Curren Bouquetd'or 
and I thoroughly watered the vast fields.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Phew— It's so hot again today. I'll need 
to do some weeding soon... They grow so 
fast when it's this warm...
choice_data_list: Whoa, this much...? Looks like tough work.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—but it truly feels like summer. The 
garden at my family's home was just like 
this, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'll find time in the early mornings or 
evenings and work on it little by little, 
so it's totally fine.
choice_data_list: Want me to help with the weeding too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all—I'd feel bad when you're 
already so busy. It's tough coordinating 
our schedules, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just the thought is more than enough. 
Thank you very much.

She's holding back... Isn't there 
something I can do to help...?
choice_data_list:
(While I have some time, I'll get a little 
bit done!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh my—? This area shouldn't have been done 
yet, and yet...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten... even more beautiful 
again... Could it be—

—Weeding whenever there was free time in 
the morning or evening had become a 
complete routine. ...Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It was you, Trainer-san, just as I 
thought. Fufu... I've finally—caught you."
choice_data_list:
Bouquet... Um, sorry for doing that 
without asking

text_block_list.text:
Having been declined once before, things 
felt a bit awkward. But as if taking 
everything in, she spoke.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um........ The sunflowers are in full 
bloom. Would you like to cool off in the 
evening breeze with me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It is truly... truly beautiful. Thanks to 
you—
choice_data_list: Bouquet...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much. You are... truly a 
kind person...

Heading out to the field, Curren 
Bouquetd'or stared intently at the sapling 
planted in the pot. It had several buds on 
it.
choice_data_list: What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A brown rose... it is. A spray rose... 
umm...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The tips branch out and bear many tiny 
blossoms... It's a lovely little rose.
choice_data_list: Wow, that's lovely, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When it blooms, I want to display it 
alongside the other pots... so I'm taking 
great care of it.

Curren Bouquetd'or speaks with a joyful 
smile. However, she suddenly mutters 
something under her breath.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“—For autumn roses, you prune the buds in 
the summer to help them store up energy.”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
By doing so, it will bear magnificent 
flowers in autumn... I, too, wish to 
become something like that—I truly do.

I thought she was almost like an Umamusume 
herself. Curren Bouquetd'or had worked so 
hard this summer too. That's why...
choice_data_list: You can definitely become it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. This autumn, I will 
surely make victory... bloom.

After that, the two of us tended to the 
rose together. Though delicate, the 
sapling showed vibrant signs of life. And 
then, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Those roses—they've bloomed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to come watch after 
training wraps up today?

She smiles in the gentle autumn breeze. I 
felt as though she was filled with a 
flexible, resilient strength, just like 
that rose.

We arrived at a field where a chilling 
wintry wind blew. Curren Bouquetd'or said 
she was going to take care of the 
pansies...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I planted a great many flowers at the end 
of autumn. Arranging them beautifully, so 
that all the various colors would be in 
harmony...
choice_data_list: It's so vibrant and wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. The scenery gets so 
lonely in winter, so I thought I would add 
a little touch of color.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Pansies are strong flowers that can even 
bloom in winter. Still... I want to 
protect them from the cold.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Plants in the ground can't be moved, so I 
need to put sheets over the soil to 
protect against frost...
choice_data_list: Okay, this is it, right? W-whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Eek... the wind is...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? Let's hold it down 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Let's move the potted plants to the 
greenhouse. Um, everything around that 
area...
choice_data_list: A-All of something that huge...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm fine. Trainer, please—don't push 
yourself. Just carry the light things, 
please.

Curren Bouquetd'or worked briskly. I tried 
my best too, but I feel like I wasn't of 
much help...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Are you alright? Are you hurt 
anywhere...?
choice_data_list:
I'm okay... Sorry I couldn't be of more 
help.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all. You were—a great 
help.

I only tagged along out of curiosity, so 
it would be awful if I became a burden... 
Just as I was thinking that...
(WHOOOOOSH!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —...gh... It's cold... isn't it?
choice_data_list:
That's it...! Can you wait a moment for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um... Ah, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —My...! It's so warm...

When I hand her the hot cocoa I bought in 
a hurry, she looks terribly apologetic.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? For me to accept this...

Whenever I saw flowers around the academy, 
they always soothed me. This morning, I 
unexpectedly got to see the secret efforts 
she put in behind the scenes...
choice_data_list: This is a thank-you gift for that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
FufuâI was the one who received your 
help, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...My hands were numb from the cold, so 
this is a huge help. Thank you—truly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... So warm— Fufufu—it feels so very 
warm.
